_comment: Single source of truth for Block Aero brand token values across newpub.
Edit ONLY this file, then run: python3 tools/apply-brand-tokens.py
It rewrites css/style.css :root, the inline tailwind.config block duplicated in
every HTML page, and js/block-aero-logo.js in one pass.
AUTHORITY: branding-kit/ is the intended source of truth. It was not reachable
when this map was written, so v3_determined below is read off the live
tokens v3 does NOT determine - see that section's own note.

v3_determined._note: Evidenced literal values from the v3 surface. Safe to apply.

--green.role: verification ticks only - demoted from field colour

_note: v3 as shipped is a DARK marketing page with a small palette. newpub is a LIGHT
enterprise theme (--bg #ffffff) with a fuller token set. These tokens have no
v3 equivalent, and substituting v3's dark-theme values would break them - most
dangerously --ink, where v3's #E8EDF5 is body text ON navy and would be
invisible on newpub's white. Left at current values until branding-kit supplies

--blue-light.problem: v3 RETIRES #2B86D4 and has no lighter blue step. Used in gradients site-wide, so it cannot simply be dropped.

--blue-tint.problem: Light-theme wash. No v3 equivalent (v3 has no light surfaces).

--navy.problem: v3 retires #0E1320. Its nearest values (#111827, #0B1220) are panel surfaces, not the heading/dark-band colour this token drives.

--navy-soft.problem: v3 retires #141C2E. Same panel-vs-token mismatch as --navy.

--ink.problem: Light-theme body text. v3's #E8EDF5 is the DARK-theme equivalent - applying it would make body copy invisible on white.

--slate.problem: Light-theme secondary text. v3's dark-theme counterpart is #9AA6B8.

--mist.problem: Light-theme tertiary text. v3's dark-theme counterpart is #6B7589.

--line.problem: Light-theme hairline. v3 uses rgba(255,255,255,.12), which is dark-theme only.

--bg.problem: newpub is light, v3 is dark-on-navy. Whether corporate goes dark is a redesign decision, not a token swap.

--font-mono.problem: v3's marketing page uses no mono. Other Block Aero surfaces disagree: IBM Plex Mono (ARM legal pages) vs SF Mono (brand-init.js).

logo_spectrum_gradient._note: Deliberate exception: the mark's gradient keeps the OLD blue at its 65% stop. Do not retarget these to #3B82F0.
